scripts.build:client: bun build src/client/admin.ts src/client/staff.ts src/client/monitor.ts src/client/provider.ts src/client/customer.ts --target=browser --outdir ./dist/public/assets
scripts.build:styles: bun build src/styles/admin.css src/styles/staff.css src/styles/monitor.css src/styles/provider.css src/styles/customer.css src/styles/auth.css --outdir ./dist/public/assets
scripts.build:assets: bun run build:client && bun run build:styles && bun run build:media
scripts.build: bun run build:server && bun run build:assets
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun test
